prompt: Build a command-line tool named textstat, invoked as the executable bin/textstat at the repo root (any language, with a shebang). If dependencies are needed, provide a setup.sh at the root that installs them. `bin/textstat FILE` prints one JSON object {"lines","words","chars","top_word"}: lines is the count of newline characters, words are whitespace-separated tokens, chars is the character count, and top_word is the most frequent word compared case-insensitively and printed lowercased (ties broken alphabetically; null for empty input). FILE may be - to read stdin. A missing file prints an error to stderr, nothing to stdout, and exits with code 2.

hidden.run: if [ -f setup.sh ]; then sh setup.sh; fi; python3 tests_hidden/test_qs.py
